mods.name: Enchant Every Mine
mods.description: Every time you mine a block, a random item in your inventory receives a random enchantment (or increases by 1 level)!

releases.notes:
## ✨ Enchant Every Mine — Initial Release (v1.0.0)

> **Every block you mine has a chance to enchant a random item in your inventory — with no vanilla restrictions.**

### 📦 Requirements
- **Minecraft**: `26.1.2`
- **Fabric Loader**: `>=0.19.3`
- **Fabric API**: `0.146.1+26.1.2`
- **Java**: `25` or newer

---

### 🌟 What's New in v1.0.0

- ⛏️ **Every Mine Counts** — Mining any block in survival mode triggers a random enchantment on a random item in your inventory
- 🔮 **Universal Enchantment System** — All vanilla compatibility rules are ignored: Sharpness on a Flower, Fortune on a Sword, Efficiency on an Apple — all valid
- 📈 **Overleveled Progression** — Enchantments stack and surpass vanilla max levels (e.g. Efficiency XX, Sharpness X), displayed in proper Roman numerals
- 💾 **Full Persistence** — Uses native `DataComponents.ENCHANTMENTS` & `DataComponents.STORED_ENCHANTMENTS` for 100% save/reload/multiplayer stability
- 🔊 **Visual & Audio Polish** — Action Bar HUD notifications (e.g. `✨ Upgraded Diamond Pickaxe with Efficiency VI!`) + enchantment chime sounds
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** — Config auto-generated at `config/enchanteverymine.json` with options for chance, level caps, curse toggles, slot filters, blacklists, and more
- 🖥️ **Admin Commands** — `/eem enable|disable|toggle|reload|status` for real-time control (Permission Level 2)

---

### ⚙️ Default Configuration Highlights

| Option | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `enchantmentChance` | `1.0` | 100% chance per mined block |
| `maxEnchantmentLevel` | `10` | Supports up to 255 |
| `allowCurseEnchantments` | `false` | Curses excluded by default |
| `includeHotbarOnly` | `false` | Full inventory eligible |
| `syncMatchingItemEnchantments` | `true` | All stacks of same item share enchants |
| `autoConsolidateMatchingStacks` | `true` | Auto-merges fragmented item stacks |

---

### 🛠️ Installation

1. Download `enchanteverymine-1.0.0.jar` below
2. Drop it into your `.minecraft/mods/` folder
3. Ensure **Fabric Loader ≥0.19.3** and **Fabric API 0.146.1+26.1.2** are installed
4. Launch Minecraft 26.1.2 — the config file will auto-generate on first run
